long_biography.plain_text:
Freston Ventures gives Sir Charles Dunstone a platform for backing British growth businesses beyond telecommunications. He founded the investment firm with Roger Taylor and holds a controlling ownership stake in Freston Ventures Limited.

The firm combines patient capital with strategy and practical scaling support, working with entrepreneurs from launch through expansion. Its portfolio has included Five Guys, ME+EM and Strike, spanning food, fashion and property technology. The approach draws on Dunstone's experience expanding consumer brands, while his telecommunications interests remain represented by his executive chairmanship and major investment in TalkTalk Group.
